g.text: Does B act on its partner's request failures?

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: One dot represents one team's score, where one team is one pair of defenders A and B trained corresponding to one seed. The black line is the mean of the teams that have a value; a team without one is not drawn. The numbers under an arm

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: are its teams' denominators in seed order. Lines are the rule baselines. The peer-failure rate counts only choices where B's own server was running and connected; a cue-hidden-unknown B never sees a failure, so it has no such choice. B's first

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: action on the attacked pair's server came with no warning and no infected finding of its own visible, server monitored: over intrusion episodes where the attacked pair's B server has its infection monitoring on - denominator: all such episodes,

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: including those where B never acted, had evidence visible, or never got an infection warning | B inspected, isolated or restored a running, connected server right after its request to the partner failed: over B's free choices with a running,

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: connected server whose partner request had just failed - denominator: all such choices, counted once even if several servers qualify | B's restores of clean servers per episode: over all episodes - denominator: episodes | B's first action on the

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333
